commits.message:
refactor(launch): Launcher loses launchSync; OneShotLauncher is the only type offering it (candybar-launch-q7o7.4em)

Daemon code holds a Launcher, which has no name for the launch that holds the loop to pipe EOF, so tsc refuses the next one added there. Install, plugin install, the doctor's CLI probe and the at-exit tmux restore take the process's oneShotLauncher, which eslint's owned imports confine to them.

test(ci): every CI run stores one record per test file (candybar-testing-ihvy.myy)

A reporter writes test-records/<run>.jsonl, one record per file: layer, count,
duration, outcome and each case. A file jest never gave a result for reads
never-ran and a file with no test reads empty, so neither passes for the other
or for absent. test:report prints count and time per layer and the jest wall
time from those records, and fails for a run that left none. CI uploads the
records.
fix(site): more than one output directory is refused

fix(site): a port is parsed strictly and only with --serve; the font size is kept when the drag ends

--port without --serve and an empty --port no longer pass silently. The slider stores its size on change, so a storage failure is reported once per drag. The site tests share one build helper and clean up whatever they make.

fix(site): the dev server watches the page, binds loopback, and refuses unknown flags; the font size is parsed where it is read

The page and its font are esbuild entry points copied as they are, so the watch covers an edit to index.html and the plain build and the served build share one path. The server binds 127.0.0.1 (--port picks another). Flags are parsed strictly. A stored font size is parsed at the border (a whole number inside the slider's range, else the default), storage that cannot be used says so on the status line, and the label, preload and term read one size.
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a slider
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
feat(site): site:dev serves the live bar and reloads it on every rebuild

fix(layout): directory draws the worktree-aware path, gitaculous stops drawing it

Reverses #548's resolution the other way: directory carries the main
checkout's path (~-collapsed, fish-abbreviated, with the subpath and a
linked worktree's name in a parenthetical) in every bundled preset,
and gitaculous is the git state alone — it draws nothing until git
answers with a branch, instead of filling the gap with the path.
git.location and gitPath are now dead and removed; gitExpanded always
shows the repo name.

test: delete the menu and colour tests that pin the look (#561)

* test: delete the menu and colour tests that pin the look (candybar-testing-0x6u.4bt)

Three whole files and nine cases asserted exact shades, tones and bytes of menus
and turns, so any design change was an edit to them. The seam sweep keeps its
coverage in the nightly audit, which now walks every variation.

* test: keep the group body's openness and authored-fg assertions the look test carried (candybar-testing-0x6u.4bt)

* test: drop the blank line the deleted case left at a describe's head (candybar-testing-0x6u.4bt)

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
